notes.title: Storyteller's Festival 2025 Feature, Art Book Discount!
notes.notes: Royce here, and I'm pleased to announce that [i]The Case of the Serialized Killer[/i] has been included in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/TwoHalfStudios/sale/TheStorytellersFestival2025]2025 Storyteller's festival![/url] To celebrate, the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2697660/Artbook__The_Case_of_the_Serialized_Killer/]art book is on sale[/url]. I hear back from a lot of folks who are shocked that the game is free, so if you'd like to support development of future games, please pick up the art book before February 24th!

notes.title: Achievements Added!
notes.notes:
Hello all! Version 1.25 is live, and it includes:

[list]
[*] Achievements! There are four in total, two based in standard progression, one for the true end, and one for getting all the endings,
[*] Minor cosmetic updates to the main menu and first scene,
[*] Assorted bug fixes
[/list]

Now's a perfect time to go in and check out all the endings. And if you haven't left a review on Steam yet, I'd love it if you did!

notes.title: See How Harold and Faraday Met in Hoping This Finds You Well, Out May 1st!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44761523/767e1948c7c44abd40ea061c9a85ddef425018c8.png[/img]

[h1]Hoping This Finds You Well is Coming to Steam![/h1]

An experiment in letter writing, meant to evoke the distinctly sweet homoerotisicm of Victorian and Edwardian literature. Follow the correspondence of two professors, in the months before one of them makes a decision he'll never be able to take back.

[list]
[*] A visual novel with a cute mechanic: Slide the letters back and forth across the screen, to experience the time the letter is written, and when it is read

[*] About 10,000 words in length

[*] Two scientists, one of them arguably quite mad

[*] New art and some control updates!
[/list]
[h1]You can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2874300/Hoping_this_Finds_You_Well/]wishlist it today![/url][/h1]

notes.title: Art Book Issues Resolved!
notes.notes:
Thank you for your patience! Those of you who have purchased the art book DLC should be getting an update soon. Once that's done, the art book will be in your local files. To access them, follow these steps:

1. Open the Steam client and find The Case of the Serialized Killer in your Library.
2. Right click on the game's name or icon, and choose "Manage" -> "Browse local files".
3. Find the The Case of the Serialized Killer Artbook zip file in the "SK122" folder.

Thanks again, and happy new year!
-Royce
